stories.title: A stencil of a handprint in an Indonesian cave is the oldest known rock art
stories.summary: Scientists have discovered what they say is the earliest known rock art, in a cave in Indonesia. They say the image dates to more than 67,000 years ago.

stories.title: Remembering actor Catherine O'Hara of 'Schitt's Creek' and 'Home Alone'
stories.summary: Actor Catherine O'Hara has died at the age of 71. She had a long career, winning an Emmy for her role on the sitcom Schitt's Creek, and spent years as a featured player in Christopher Guest movies.

stories.title: How the blockade between Afghanistan and Pakistan is affecting people on both sides
stories.summary: Borders between Pakistan and Afghanistan have been closed since October, disrupting trade around the region. It's part of a broader dispute over how to handle increasingly active militant groups.

stories.title: Residents in Nashville still struggle with power outages a week after winter storm
stories.summary: Residents of Nashville are still struggling to recover from a winter storm as more freezing weather is expected this weekend.

stories.title: States look at banning masked agents, but local police have doubts
stories.summary: We look at the potential for conflict between local police and federal immigration agents as Democratic states consider banning law enforcement from wearing masks or otherwise concealing their IDs.

stories.title: DOJ says it has met legal obligations with latest Epstein files release
stories.summary: The Justice Department says it has released more than 3 million pages of materials tied to convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, to comply with the law.
